name: Krom Stoutarm
summary: Krom Stoutarm is a dwarven scholar and warlock found deep within the Library of the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. Unlike most of his kin who delve solely into ancient stone and titan relics, Krom studies darker, arcane texts and demonic rituals. He acts as an indispensable contact for Alliance warlocks seeking esoteric knowledge across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

sections.title: A Darker Corner of the Hall
sections.body: The Hall of Explorers is typically known for dwarven archaeologists obsessed with picks, shovels, and titan artifacts. Krom Stoutarm cuts an unusual figure among them. Lurking in the Library surrounded by massive tomes, he pursues occult lore and the binding rites of demonic summoners. His presence in Ironforge demonstrates that while warlock arts are widely distrusted, scholar-practitioners who study the forbidden arts still operate within the mountain city's halls.

sections.title: The Tome of the Cabal
sections.body: When Alliance warlocks seek to bind potent demonic servants like the felhunter, their journey inevitably crosses paths with Krom. Possessing knowledge of scattered occult volumes, he directs aspiring summoners far across the seas—including dangerous forays into hostile territories like the Barrens—to recover torn pages and fragments of the infamous Tome of the Cabal.

faq.q: Where can I find Krom Stoutarm?
faq.answer: Krom Stoutarm is located inside the Library wing of the Hall of Explorers in the dwarven capital of Ironforge.

faq.q: What role does Krom Stoutarm play for players?
faq.answer: Krom serves as a crucial quest contact for Alliance warlocks pursuing their class-defining demonic rituals, particularly guiding them through the retrieval of the Tome of the Cabal.

faq.q: Is Krom Stoutarm related to other Stoutarms?
faq.answer: Several dwarves share the Stoutarm surname, but a family relationship between Krom and the others is unconfirmed.

faq.q: Why is a warlock permitted inside the Hall of Explorers?
aliases: why is krom in hall of explorers
faq.answer: Krom is both a warlock and a scholar working from the Hall of Explorers. The source does not explain the terms under which his work is permitted.

faq.q: Why is Krom connected to the Barrens?
faq.answer: In his research into dark manuscripts, Krom sends warlocks to retrieve lost segments of the Tome of the Cabal, with one such critical piece hidden in a chest deep within the Quillboar-infested lands of the Barrens.
Krom is a scholarly quest giver rather than a standard class trainer. He directs warlocks along specific rites of passage rather than teaching everyday grimoires.

angles.text: Alliance warlocks must consult Krom during their pursuit of dark bindings, notably the dangerous task of assembling the Tome of the Cabal.
Dwarves usually disown the fell arts, making Krom's position among the revered shelves of the Hall of Explorers a curious rarity.
Krom provides the Alliance's covert practitioners a safe intellectual haven within Ironforge's mighty mountain bastions.
